images.scene: Inside the cave dwelling, Friday kneels and presses a small hatchet into Robinson's hands, offering himself to be killed rather than be sent away, tears standing in his eyes while Robinson recoils in surprise.
images.alt: A kneeling man offers a hatchet to another man, tears in his eyes, begging not to be sent away.

images.scene: Robinson and Friday stand over a huge felled tree trunk near the shore, hewing and chopping its outside into the shape of a boat with axes, wood chips scattered on the ground around the half-finished hull.
images.alt: Two men shape a large canoe from a felled tree trunk with axes near the shore.

images.scene: Friday vaults over the wooden outer fence of the fortification in mid-air, arms flung out and face full of terror, running back to warn Robinson that canoes have landed on the shore.
images.alt: A frightened man leaps over a wooden fence, running to raise the alarm.

images.scene: Robinson crouches at the top of a grassy hill holding a long brass perspective glass to his eye, looking down at a distant beach where a crowd of savages gather around canoes and a smoking fire for their feast.
images.alt: A man on a hilltop looks through a spyglass toward a distant beach gathering.

images.scene: From behind trees at the edge of the wood, Robinson and Friday kneel shoulder to shoulder firing muskets in a burst of smoke toward the startled savages scattering across the sand near their fire.
images.alt: Two men fire muskets from the edge of a wood at figures scattering on a beach.

images.scene: Inside a beached canoe, Friday throws his arms around a frail old bound man he has just freed, hugging and kissing him with wild joy while Robinson stands beside the boat watching the reunion.
images.alt: A young man joyfully embraces a frail old man he has just freed in a beached canoe.
